trigger: First execution attempt stopped at the source continuity gate before signal generation or outcome evaluation because the already-audited historical MEXC parent corpus contains sparse 15-minute gaps.

policy.derived_bar_requirement: Every retained 12H/8H/4H bar must contain every expected 15-minute timestamp exactly once.
policy.signal_generation: Signals may be generated only inside a contiguous derived-bar segment with sufficient local lookback and ATR warmup.
policy.trade_path: A scored trade must have its complete frozen max-hold execution path inside the same contiguous derived-bar segment and inside the window boundary; otherwise it is right-censored and not scored.
policy.gap_reporting: Report raw gap counts, dropped derived bars, contiguous segment counts and any affected signals for every asset/cell.

consistency: This matches the parent corpus fail-closed principle: gaps are preserved and split, never filled or hidden.
